text:
Which statement about calcium carbonate is correct?
A
It is made by the thermal decomposition of limestone.
B
It is used to neutralise alkaline soils.
C
It is a reactant in the test for carbon dioxide.
D
It is used to remove impurities in iron extraction.

options.label: A
options.text: It is made by the thermal decomposition of limestone.

options.label: B
options.text: It is used to neutralise alkaline soils.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a reactant in the test for carbon dioxide.

options.label: D
options.text: It is used to remove impurities in iron extraction.
